build_kinematic_relationship_manager: build a KinematicRelationshipManager instance attached to a Habitat simulator to track object kinematic relationships
add_relation_to_graph: add a parent-child relationship to the RelationshipGraph with a specified relationship type string
apply_relationships_snapshot: apply cached parent-to-child transformation matrices recursively down the kinematic tree in the simulator
initialize_from_obj_to_rec_pairs: initialize the relationship graph from object-to-receptacle mappings found in a RearrangeEpisode
get_human_readable_relationship_forest: get a human-readable dictionary of the relationship forest mapping object names to their children and types
